title: 聊天｜成功率与首发失败
description: 用户视角成功率与首发平台+模型失败率（报错/中断/拒答/超时）。只看在架模型。数据：st_chat_turns_total，在架名单 st_chat_model_listed。 兜底模型视图：st_chat_fallbacks_total（付费/畅聊分开，只记兜底真正用上的轮次）。

list.name: lane
list.label: 栏目
list.query: 全部 : chat|free_zone, 付费聊天 : chat, 畅聊 : free_zone

list.name: fail_type
list.label: 失败类型
list.query: 全部 : error|interrupted|refused|timeout, 报错 : error, 中断 : interrupted, 拒答 : refused, 超时 : timeout

list.name: model
list.label: 模型
list.description: 在架的平台 · 模型，可多选。只决定最下面出哪些模型的小图。
list.definition: query_result(count by (model, platform, pm) (label_join(label_replace((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())), "m", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)"), "pm", " · ", "platform", "m")))
list.query: query_result(count by (model, platform, pm) (label_join(label_replace((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())), "m", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)"), "pm", " · ", "platform", "m")))

panels.title: 大盘
用户成功率
panels.description: 用户视角：首发 + 首字兜底 + 出字后重写共同作用之后，用户最终拿到正常回答的比例。不计余额/VIP 拒绝和用户停止。

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[$__range]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end()))) / sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())))

panels.title: 首发成功率
panels.description: 首发模型自己的表现。报错：出字前就失败（含由兜底交付的）；中断：出字后卡住/流内错误/断开/被截断；拒答：正文开头命中运营词池或供应商内容过滤；超时：首字兜底真正替它交付，或谁都没出字。

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[$__range]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end()))) / sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())))

panels.title: 聊天轮数
panels.description: 时间范围内用户发起的聊天（含重新生成）。

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())))

panels.title: 兜底救回的轮数
panels.description: 首发失败、由首字兜底或出字后重写救回、用户最终拿到正常回答的轮数。

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue!="none"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue!="none"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue!="none"}[$__range]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())))

panels.title: 成功率走势（近 1 小时滚动）
panels.description: 用户成功率 vs 首发成功率；两条线之间的差就是兜底救回的部分。

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[1h]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end()))) / sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())))

sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[1h]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end()))) / sum((last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) * 0) and on (platform, model, lane) group by (platform, model, lane) (st_chat_model_listed{deployment_environment_name="production"} @ end())))

panels.title: 视图 1 · 每个模型的用户失败率（直接对应用户体验）
每个模型的用户失败率（按失败类型分色）
panels.description: 用户视角：首发 + 首字兜底 + 出字后重写共同作用之后，用户最终没拿到正常回答的比例。 模型按用户所选模型对应的首发平台 + 模型列出；受顶部「失败类型」筛选。

panels.title: 口径说明

options.content:
- **一次调用** = 用户发起的一轮聊天（含重新生成）；余额/VIP 拒绝、用户主动停止不计。
- **用户失败**：首发 + 首字兜底 + 出字后重写之后，用户最终仍是报错、中断、拒答或超时。
- **首发失败**：报错＝出字前失败（含由兜底交付）；中断＝出字后卡住（运营配置 stall_ms）、流内错误、断开或被截断；拒答＝正文开头 check_chars 个字命中运营平台「出字后兜底」词池，或供应商内容过滤；超时＝首字兜底真正替它交付，或谁都没出字。
- 平台 + 模型取用户所选模型对应的首发。数据来自后端指标 `st_chat_turns_total`（2026-11-24 起），按区间末值减起点值计数（不用 increase，避免漏掉新组合的第一条）。
- **只看在架模型**：付费模型目录里启用的 + 畅聊在架的（后端每 15 秒上报 `st_chat_model_listed`）。按看板时间范围终点那一刻的名单过滤，走势和按小时图也一样；下架模型的历史不显示，在架但这段时间没人用的模型不出现。
- 顶部「模型」（平台 · 模型，可多选）只决定最下面出哪些模型的小图，其余面板始终列出全部在架模型。
- 阈值：单类 <2% 绿、2–5% 黄、≥5% 红；总失败率与成功率卡片另有阈值。
- **兜底模型（视图 4，2026-11-26 起）**：数据来自 `st_chat_fallbacks_total`，平台 + 模型是兜底那一路（付费走模型目录兜底，畅聊走畅聊专用兜底）。只记兜底真正决定用户结果的调用：首字兜底只在首发没交付时记（兜底发出后首发先出字＝没用上，不记）；出字后重写每次真正发出都记。成功率＝成功 ÷ 记下的兜底次数；失败原因细到上游状态码（404/429/5xx…）、网络错误、流内报错、内容过滤、卡住/断开、到首字总上限没出字、命中拒答词池。不受顶部「栏目」「失败类型」筛选，也不按在架名单过滤。
